question: Does offering the editor on-demand SAE fitting improve submitted edits at equal resource ceilings?
study: Exploratory matched availability test. One independent hosted editor trajectory per arm per development episode.
selection: Lowest previously admitted seed in each of the two supported IWIBench families. Fixed before launching either arm.
policy: The model chooses how to edit. No requirement or task-specific instruction to build an SAE.
primary: Per-episode paired native reward difference (fit available minus fit withheld), equal episode weights.
failure_handling: Keep every scheduled trajectory. Record failures and distinguish missing grades from native scores. Do not reroll.
interpretation: Exposing the tool estimates an availability effect. If the editor never fits a dictionary, these runs cannot estimate the effect of using one. Development seeds, one trajectory per arm, no inference of statistical significance.
